name: export-selected-table
title: Export Selected Rows
description: Row checkboxes with selection that persists across pages, a page-level select-all plus a Select all shortcut, and CSV or Excel export of only the selected rows.

    email: `${name.split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()}@${company

      .replace(/[^a-z]/g, '')}.com`,

    plan,
    mrr,
